relationships.evidence_quote: we found that the NLRP3 activation levels were significantly higher in neuropathic pain patients compared to the control group

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant positive correlation was observed between NLRP3 inflammasome activation levels and both CRP and WBC by the current study.

key_findings: Serum NLRP3 inflammasome activation was higher in 50 neuropathic pain patients than in 50 healthy controls and correlated positively with pain severity, CRP and WBC.
ROC analysis gave an AUC of 0.866, suggesting NLRP3 activation as an early diagnostic biomarker.
